nodes.rationale: Project Orion as-built documentation from 2024 contains '22 kW' but this is a DIFFERENT project. The document accurately records what was installed in Orion. Must be preserved as historical record; do not edit.

nodes.title: TASK-001: Electrical preparation — Atlas motor mount
nodes.rationale: Task for electrical preparation and motor mount for Atlas. The motor mount design and electrical sizing likely depend on the motor rating, but the snippet does not contain the literal value. Human review needed to assess whether completed work is affected by the power reduction.

surfaceProps.impactStatement: The motor mount design and electrical sizing for TASK-001 were likely based on the 22 kW rating. The reduction to 18.5 kW may affect mounting dimensions, cable sizing, and protection settings. Completed work should be reviewed to determine if rework is needed.
